title: Monkey dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 70 Q10 72 14 52 Q16 42 26 46' fill='none' stroke='#b5651d' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='70' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#8b4a12'/>
  <rect x='54' y='70' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='91' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#5a2d05'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='89' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#d98436'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='17' ry='19' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#e0a060'/>
  <!-- arms raised, dancing -->
  <path d='M36 50 Q22 40 20 26' fill='none' stroke='#b5651d' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 50 Q78 42 82 28' fill='none' stroke='#8b4a12' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='24' r='5.5' fill='#e0a060'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='26' r='5.5' fill='#d98436'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='16' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='30' r='6' fill='#e0a060'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='30' r='6' fill='#d98436'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#3a1e05'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='30' r='2.6' fill='#3a1e05'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 37 Q50 43 56 37' fill='none' stroke='#3a1e05' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#8b4a12'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <circle cx='78' cy='12' r='3.5'/>
    <rect x='80' y='2' width='2' height='11' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='10' r='3'/>
    <rect x='26' y='1' width='1.8' height='10' fill='#ffe066'/>
  </g>
</svg>
